summary: Sets or clears bit 7 (0x80) of the byte pointed to by this, depending on argument a2: nonzero a2 stores 0x80, zero a2 ANDs out the 0x80 bit. Returns a2 unchanged. No callees.

operations.description: Save the incoming a2 as the value to return.
Branch on a2: if nonzero, set bit 7; if zero, clear bit 7.
When a2 is nonzero, store 0x80 into the byte at this (offset 0x0), setting bit 7.
When a2 is zero, clear bit 7 of the byte at this (offset 0x0) via AND with the bitwise complement of 0x80.

unresolved: Purpose of the bit-7 flag at this+0x0 is unknown; callers DispatchWrapper and FloatComputation do not reveal it here.
